channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: AI uncovers chemical shortcut to turn CO2 into fuel
item.description: Scientists used artificial intelligence to identify nearly 10,000 chemical reactions for converting carbon dioxide into fuels and chemicals.

item.title: AI can mimic humans, but is still not seen as conscious
item.description: A new study finds people draw a sharp line between human consciousness and artificial intelligence, even when both behave identically.

item.title: Planet 320 light-years away confirms long-suspected chemical link
item.description: Astronomers found a scorching-hot planet 320 light-years away with a striking chemical similarity to its host star, offering evidence for a long-suspected process.

item.title: Gigantic prehistoric snake found in India may rank among largest
item.description: A massive prehistoric snake discovered in India may have rivaled the largest known. Named Vasuki indicus, the 47-million-year-old giant could have been among the biggest ever.
